verdict.rationale: Godot is MIT-licensed with "no strings attached, no royalties," free for any purpose, and its license terms do not apply to the games you make. With no fees or royalties to reprice, a retroactive charge on shipped games is effectively not possible. Community comments add that it imposes no splash-screen or attribution requirements. missing for 10: explicit documented history showing the license and pricing have stayed unchanged over time, independent corroboration of that stability track record.
